review_method: blind DeepSeek review followed by Codex review of all low-confidence and non-default labels

codex_cross_review.scope: all low-confidence cases, all partial labels, and all high-control non-correct labels
codex_cross_review.finding: Low-score partial labels were translation mismatches under the corpus-fidelity rubric. Several high-control partial labels were conservative judge errors, but none was rejected as mismatch.

decision: The model-assisted reject-precision gate passed for a non-destructive 1M shadow run. It does not authorize deleting or rewriting source rows.
limitations: The calibration is model-assisted rather than an independent professional bilingual annotation.
The high-control set contains extreme high scores and does not estimate behavior across the full clean distribution.
Thresholds must remain reversible manifests until downstream training ablation confirms benefit.
